title: Fix Manage topbar button misleading label - it opens a delete modal not an engagement manager
goal: Rename the 'Manage' button in the topbar engagement area to 'Delete Stale...' or 'Cleanup...' so the label accurately describes the action (bulk-delete stale engagements with dry-run preview). The delete modal content and behavior remains unchanged. No new engagement edit form is required in this task - just fix the label to match the action.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: Topbar shows a 'Manage' button next to the engagement selector. Clicking it opens a DATA CLEANUP delete-only modal. There is no way to create, rename, or archive an engagement from this flow. The label 'Manage' implies CRUD operations but delivers delete-only. This is a critical UX mismatch flagged as Critical in the walkthrough report.
